trailhead.label: The Chalet Montefalcone below Monte Falcone, Recoaro Terme, the published start

cautions: The ridge path is a mountain path (T2) with uneven ground and loose stones: keep a steady pace and watch your dog’s paws.
Cows graze the ridge pastures in summer: keep your dog on a lead and give the herds room.
The ridge is open: avoid it in thunderstorms, wind or mist.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
